subject: AWS Marketplace: SaaS usage ledger, billing recon & IP clause check
messages:
From: Tyler Nguyen <tyler.nguyen@amazon.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick: usage ledger & reconciliation expectations for Sekai Health listing

Hi Olga,

We're preparing the final fulfillment checklist for Sekai Health's SaaS listing and had two items where we need clarification before PRD sign-off:

1) Usage ledger retention and reconciliation cadence — Sekai expects daily aggregated usage + monthly reconciliation for billing disputes. Is Redwood able to surface a signed, immutable per-customer usage ledger (exportable) that we can reference for disputed invoices?

2) IP / resale restrictions — your procurement asked about a short clause to ensure marketplace entitlements cannot be resold by third parties. Can you confirm a short sentence that legal is comfortable with to include in the marketplace amendment?

If you prefer, we can jump on a 30-min call. Tyler
Marketplace Partner Ops — AWS

From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Date: 2027-04-25T10:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick: usage ledger & reconciliation expectations for Sekai Health listing

Olga / Ben —

Summary proposal for ledger and contract language below. Kept it concise to help legal and AWS review quickly.

Ledger export (proposed): CSV / gzipped daily bundles pushed to S3 with the following fields: date_utc, customer_account_id, marketplace_entitlement_id, timestamps_first_token, timestamps_last_token, tokens_consumed, request_count, model_variant, request_region, signature_hash. We retain daily bundles for 13 months by default (can be extended per contract). Each bundle will be cryptographically signed (HMAC) by Redwood's key and we can provide the HMAC verification key to authorized AWS/Sekai contacts.

Retention & reconciliation cadence: daily exports for automated billing + monthly summarized reconciliation report (CSV + PDF) showing aggregated consumption, discrepancies, and any adjustments. Dispute window: 90 days from invoice date (we can discuss shortening).

Suggested short contract sentence for marketplace amendment (first draft):
"Redwood Inference will provide daily immutable usage records for the SaaS offering in a machine-readable format, accessible to AWS Marketplace and the Purchaser. Such records are intended for billing reconciliation and shall serve as the authoritative source for usage-based charges, subject to the dispute resolution process in Section X."

Note: legal may want to add limits around forensic review or be explicit about HMAC verification. If legal prefers, we can offer a one-sentence alternative that avoids the word 'authoritative' and references 'mutually-agreed reconciliation process.'

I attached a mapping CSV that shows how entitlements map to our internal sku/tokens.

-Karthik
Sr. Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations

Attachment: mpx-entitlement-mapping.csv (stub)

From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tyler Nguyen <tyler.nguyen@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick: usage ledger & reconciliation expectations for Sekai Health listing

Looping Tyler so AWS sees our proposed operational approach.

Operational confirmation: we can deliver the daily signed bundles to an S3 bucket (either ours with cross-account access or a customer-managed bucket) and push a monthly consolidated reconciliation PDF. For high-value customers we support signed ledger snapshots (PDF + verification metadata) that a procurement or auditor can retain.

Dispute flow we propose:
- Customer raises dispute within 90 days to procurement@sekaihealth.com and redwood-billing@redwoodinference.com
- We produce a reconciliation packet (signed CSV bundle + query logs) within 5 business days
- If disagreement persists, we escalate to AWS Marketplace ops for mediation per the marketplace dispute clause.

Billing implications: any post-invoice adjustments (>1% of monthly spend) will be documented and either credited on next invoice or billable as a separate pro forma depending on the root cause. We recommend Sekai enable a one-invoice-lag buffer during the first two months of marketplace listing to smooth onboarding differences.

HubSpot note: DEAL-2027-0912 updated with reconciliation language and SLA terms (linked).

Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
